text:
Detroit comes in winless in four (0-4-0), outscored 13-5 in that stretch, after Tuesday's 3-2 loss at St. Louis. The Red Wings are without Dylan Larkin (suspension) and Albert Johansson, and Alex DeBrincat has taken Larkin's spot on the top line beside Lucas Raymond and Viktor Arvidsson. Florida beat Columbus 4-1 on Tuesday but is 2-3-0 in its last five, still missing Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand. Matthew Tkachuk has moved into Barkov's spot beside Sam Reinhart and Brady Tkachuk, and Lars Eller is up to 16:44 a night. Detroit won the first meeting 5-3 on Nov. 2.

Our numbers see little between them. Each team has taken 52% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at five on five, but Detroit has slipped to 44% over its last five games while Florida sits at 52%. Special teams tilt toward Florida: its power play creates 1.17 expected goals a game against a Detroit penalty kill allowing 0.75, though the Panthers take 5.7 penalties a game. In net, projected starter John Gibson is 6.1 goals worse than expected this season, while Jacob Markstrom is 1.2 better, though last year was the reverse for both.

Reinhart is our top scoring pick at 40% to score and sits two points from 700 for his career. Matthew Tkachuk has a five-game point streak and a 74% chance of a point. Arvidsson has gone six games without a goal on 2.5 expected, so the chances are coming.
